newsitem.title: FINLAND: SANTASALO STUDIES PRODUCT RANGE EXPANSION.
newsitem.headline: SANTASALO STUDIES PRODUCT RANGE EXPANSION.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Santasalo-JOT Oy said on Tuesday it was exploring prospects for a "significant expansion" of its product range at its manufacturing unit in Karkkila.

"Santasalo-JOT Oy's subsidiary specialised in industrial gear manuacturing, Santasalo Oy, is studying the opportunities for a significant expansion of its product range," Santasalo said in a statement.
"This is a product development project, which we have not yet made public," Santasalo's chief financial officer Jari Melgin told Reuters by phone, declining to provide more detail.
The value of the investment would be 55 million markka. The final decision to go ahead had not yet been made.
Last week, the Labour Ministry granted Santasalo six million markka in investment support linked to job creation.
The project would create 65 new jobs in Karkkila, Santasalo said in the statement.
